description: I'm a student passionate about game development, coding, software, web development, design, art and animation. I'm fascinated by space exploration, especially the Moon and Mars. I'd love to build an interactive, engaging space-themed game that makes science fun. I'm looking for creative teammates skilled in programming, game/web development, UI/UX, animation, 3D modelling, and scientific research. Enthusiasm and teamwork matter more than experience. Let's build something out of this world! 🚀
